title: England captain Harry Kane is expected to miss ‘a few months’ with ankle injury - CNN
description: England soccer captain Harry Kane will miss the “next few months” after tearing a ligament in his left ankle during Bayern Munich’s 1-1 draw against Cologne on Friday.

title: Palisades fire: Man guilty of starting one of California's deadliest blazes - BBC
description: The 30-year-old LA resident was convicted of arson leading to wildfires that killed 12 people and destroyed more than 6,800 buildings.

title: Judge approves $7.25bn Bayer settlement for Roundup cancer claims - BBC
description: The settlement will be paid by Bayer to users who already have non-Hodgkin lymphoma and those who fall ill in the future.
